div.head: Abt 71
div.ab: Æt þam oðrum taum gehwilcum healf gelde, ealswa æt þam fingrum ys cwiden.
Æt þam oðrum taum gehwilcum, healfe gelde ealswa æt þam fingrum ys cwiden.
For each of the other toes let him pay half the amount already discussed for the fingers.
For each of the other toes, [a sum] equal to half that laid down for the corresponding fingers shall be paid.
Bei den anderen Zehen allen zahle er [ebenfalls] je halb so [viel], wie bei den Fingern [oben] verkündet worden ist.
For all the other toes let him pay [likewise] half as [much] each as has been declared [above] for the fingers.
